item.text:
**Findings**
- Medium: the remaining settings data stores still duplicated boolean key routing by hand. Four classes were each doing the same null checks and `switch (key)` dispatch, which made the settings layer verbose and easy to drift.

I refactored that into [BooleanPreferenceStore.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/BooleanPreferenceStore.java:8), a small shared binding helper for boolean preference keys. The converted stores now just declare bindings instead of hand-rolling dispatch: [TerminalIOPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux/TerminalIOPreferencesFragment.java:32), [TerminalViewPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux/TerminalViewPreferencesFragment.java:32), [termux/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java:44), and [termux_float/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/fragments/settings/termux_float/DebuggingPreferencesFragment.java:38).

Static verification shows those four stores no longer contain switch-based boolean routing; the dispatch logic now exists only in the shared helper. I could not run a build or tests because `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` is missing and `gradle` is not installed in this workspace.
